name: The Fall of Camelot: The Betrayal of Guinevere & Lancelot
source:
The Kingdom of Camelot and King Arthur…

The greatest legacy ever foretold throughout the world.
Its lessons of chivalry and honor continue to make an impact on all those who read to this very day.
However, the awesome tale of Arthur would come to a horrifying crashing end…

Queen Guinevere, the love of Arthur’s life and the sun in his dark world,
is ensnared by Lancelot's selfish and manipulative web—the strongest knight of Camelot. Lusting for the Queen,
he latches onto her and convinces her to please him in secret.
This forbidden relationship of lust and pleasure will put true love to the test and ultimately bring about a tragedy for all parties involved.

The Descent of Arthur,
The Horrors of Lancelot, and the Misery of Guinevere.
It all starts with the act of bitter betrayal…​

translation:
卡米洛王国和亚瑟王……

世界各地曾预言过的最伟大的遗产。
它的骑士精神和荣誉教训至今仍对所有阅读者产生影响。
然而，亚瑟的精彩故事却以可怕的崩溃告终……

桂妮薇儿王后，亚瑟一生的挚爱，亚瑟黑暗世界中的阳光，
被兰斯洛特的自私和操纵性的网所困——卡米洛特最强的骑士。对女王的渴望，
他紧紧抓住她，并说服她暗中取悦他。
这种禁欲与享乐的关系将考验真爱，并最终给各方带来悲剧。

亚瑟王的后裔，
兰斯洛特的恐怖和格尼薇儿的痛苦。
这一切都始于痛苦的背叛行为……​
